mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers a flight to quality in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and new housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising input costs (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the risk of stagflation increases, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or the Rank IC for the regime condition over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (RSAFS) falls below its 12-month moving average by more than 5%, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS falls below its 12-month moving average by 5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% YoY) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the central bank is likely in a tightening cycle, which increases the discount rate and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 4.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% relative to its 12-month average signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
